title: Ulyana and the Gravity
author: M. M. Blackwood
blurb: Rosalind Ashgrove, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
